title: CO2 capture by carboxylate ionic liquids: fine-tuning the performance by altering hydrogen bonding motifs
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,2952-2961
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00108K, Paper

Mohammad Yousefe, Katarzyna Glińska, Michael Sweeney, Leila Moura, Małgorzata Swadźba-Kwaśny, Alberto Puga
Carbon dioxide chemisorption mechanisms are heavily influenced by the nature of hydrogen-bond donors, either hydration water or intramolecular hydroxyl groups in choline cations, in carboxylate ionic liquids.
